# Final Review Proposal
**Producer:** agent:codex/gpt-5.5-xhigh

## Summary

Reviewed the branch diff/status and the changed implementation paths. `nix develop --command cargo test --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --workspace`, and `nix build` passed. Found one user-facing documentation correctness gap.

## Amendments

1. `docs/secret_sharing.md` still documents several stale user-facing details that no longer match the branch: line 98 lists `--wallet-file-type` for `split-secret`, but the CLI explicitly has no such flag and hardcodes VSS shares to `V0Standard` in `src/main.rs:552` and `src/main.rs:1250`; lines 110 and 115 present `--display-mnemonic` as the way to show output, but the flag is hidden/deprecated in `src/main.rs:596` and ignored while the mnemonic is printed unconditionally in `src/commands/combine_secret.rs:168`; lines 143 and 153 show JSON values (`"single"`, `"segwit_native"`) that do not match the serializers (`"singlesig"` at `frozenkrill-core/src/wallet_description.rs:119`, `"segwit-native"` at `frozenkrill-core/src/wallet_description.rs:157`). This will lead users following the guide to pass unsupported flags or misunderstand the actual share payload; update the guide to match the current CLI and serialized values.
   Classification: fix_current_bead
   Rationale: The documentation is part of the reviewed branch and now contradicts the implemented CLI/API behavior in ways that affect user commands and recovery expectations.
